English: Herbal Patch
A makeshift area for gathering and cultivating wild herbs, tended by wise-women and healers for basic remedies.
Medicine Tent
A simple felt tent where basic treatments are administered and sick kin are isolated from the main camp.
Basic Infirmary
A more organized space of hides and wooden frames, where the wounded and sick are tended and cared for by designated healers.
Shamanic Shelter
A spiritual tent where shamans and healers perform rituals, offer herbal brews, and invoke the spirits to ward away disease.
Wound Care Pavilion
A large, reinforced tent for treating injuries from battle, equipped with better supplies and more skilled healers.
Healers Hut
A semi-permanent wooden hut where experienced healers reside, offering advanced care and herbal remedies for the clans ailments.
Remedy Room
A sturdy, multi-purpose shelter where both traditional remedies and rudimentary surgical procedures are performed by clan healers.
Expanded Infirmary
A large, well-constructed facility with space for many patients, managed by a staff of skilled herbalists and healers.
Recovery Hall
A sophisticated, semi-permanent structure dedicated to the long-term recovery and care of the clans sick and wounded.
Grand Nomad Hospital
A legendary center of nomadic medicine, combining advanced herbalism, surgery, and shamanic healing for the entire clan confederation.
